PyMuPDF Page Rasterization (outside Docling): page images retained only for VLM region crops and signature detection
Docling Layout Model: page segmentation into heading / paragraph / caption / list / table regions. Runs FIRST - it decides what a region is before any text is read.

TableFormer (ACCURATE, forced repo-wide): predicts table STRUCTURE only - it never reads text. do_cell_matching = False, so each cell's text comes from backend.get_text_in_rect(), a pure geometry lookup over that same text-cell list - so OCR text DOES reach table cells on PDFs. Raw image files are the exception: image_backend.get_text_in_rect() always returns empty.
XML Fast Path: direct Aadhaar XML field parser
Script-Aware OCR Router + ScriptDetector: superseded by per-doc-type DoclingOptions profiles (ocr_router = None in DocumentProcessor)

RapidOCR PP-OCRv6: Docling's OCR engine (RapidOcrOptions, ONNX Runtime). DB detection + recognition, English + Hindi. Runs AFTER layout, BEFORE TableFormer, and writes its text cells into page.parsed_page - the SAME SegmentedPdfPage object the page backend hands out.
Standalone RapidOCR PP-OCRv5 track: Devanagari is now handled inside Docling via ocr_lang = [english, hindi]
Layout Element Confidence Evaluator: char-level scoring, garbled-text and handwriting detection
Gemini VLM Fallback: re-reads cropped low-confidence Docling layout elements; corrected text replaces the element in place (external API)

Document Serializer + TableRegionMask: unifies Docling elements, tables and VLM corrections into one ParsedDocument, de-duplicating elements that fall inside table regions

Node 5 emits one verdict per checkpoint: VERIFIED / DISCREPANCY / INDETERMINATE / NOT_APPLICABLE, each with a confidence score, the compared field values, and page-anchored document evidence. DISCREPANCY and INDETERMINATE are what land in the reviewer's queue.
CP 1 - Loan Amount [Financial]: Loan amount must be consistent across all agreement and sanction records.
CP 2 - Loan Validity [Financial]: Sanction tenure must match the requested application tenure.
CP 3 - Application Form [Identity and KYC] <-- signature verifier agent: Form must be complete, SIGNED, and applicant details must match LOS.
CP 4 - KYC [Identity and KYC]: PAN and address proof are mandatory and must match the application form.
CP 5 - Selfie / Live Photo [Identity and KYC]: Live selfie face embedding must match the form photo (threshold >= 0.90).
CP 6 - Loan Agreement [Legal and Compliance] <-- signature verifier agent: Agreement presence and execution signature verification (pyHanko + OTP).
CP 7 - KFS [Financial]: KFS funding amount, IRR, EMI and customer consent must match LOS.
CP 8 - Sanction Letter [Financial]: Sanction terms (amount, tenure, IRR, EMI) must match approved LOS terms.
CP 9 - Aadhaar XML [Identity and KYC]: Aadhaar XML is a mandatory hard gate for every case.
CP 10 - BPI [Financial]: Broken period interest split must be consistent across documents and LOS.
CP 11 - Disbursal Memo [Financial]: Memo amount must be >= 90% of the approved loan amount; loan ID must match.
CP 12 - BT Details [Legal and Compliance]: BT details required for Balance Transfer loans, otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE.
12 checkpoint verdicts
